svg.title: C06-M01-F3: Stateless HTTP plus cookies equals sessions
svg.desc: A flow showing login creating a session cookie that the browser returns on each request so the server can identify the user, with the safety requirements listed.
svg.text: C06-M01-F3 Stateless HTTP plus cookies equals sessions
login -> server creates session, returns Set-Cookie: session=ID
browser stores ID, sends Cookie: session=ID on EVERY later request
server looks up ID -> knows the user -> identity across requests
safety: ID must be random + unforgeable; cookie HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite
Figure C06-M01-F3. Cookies carry a session identifier that turns a stateless protocol
